The desktop app can act, behind a token nothing else on the box has

DESKTOP.md §5 step 4b: the app's first write path. Six actions -
doctor, reindex, sync, annotate, relink, reconcile - each a thin
argument translation over the SAME pure `run*` function its CLI
command uses, so the GUI cannot drift from the CLI.

The guards, all tested rather than trusted:
- The endpoints do not EXIST without a launch token. `git for-ai
  review` passes none, so browser mode answers 404 for actions and is
  as read-only as it ever was; every other non-GET is still 405 in
  both modes. REVIEW_UI.md §2 rule 2 amended in place, not violated.
- Fresh random token per server launch, minted by the Electron main
  process and handed to its OWN renderer in the URL fragment - never
  sent to a server, wiped from the address bar on read. No endpoint
  serves it: anything on localhost can GET /api/meta, so a token that
  /api/meta returned would protect nothing. A test asserts /api/meta's
  payload does not contain it.
- Constant-time comparison, required in a header (a cross-origin form
  cannot set one), cross-origin Origin refused outright.
- One job at a time (409 otherwise): two reindexes would fight over
  the index and the machine's RAM.
- Jobs, not blocking requests. A reindex is minutes; a request that
  hangs that long is the bug we just spent the morning fixing. Every
  action returns a job id immediately and reports progress as it goes
  - reindex's per-batch lines are what make the wait honest.
- Pushing requires `confirmed: true` in the body. It is the one action
  that sends recorded reasoning off this machine, the CLI has always
  asked first, and a GUI that quietly dropped the question would be a
  less careful tool, not a more convenient one. The panel asks in the
  same terms the CLI prompt uses.

Panel v1 has the three verbs a person actually reaches for: run a
checkup, update search, fetch / send to remote. LEFT OUT DELIBERATELY,
and said so in DESKTOP.md: annotate, relink and reconcile are served
but have no UI - annotate wants a real form, and the repair verbs
belong on attention items (guided repair), which is the next
increment.

Tests: 655 green, 10 new covering the guards specifically (no token,
wrong token of equal length, cross-origin, unknown action, malformed
body, token required to read job state, and a browser-mode server
proving the routes are absent). Verified live against this repo: 401
without a token, 202 with, doctor job completing with 11 checks, push
refused without confirmation, and /api/meta not leaking the token.
